title: Limitations of the convention's own repository

entities.title: Exempt from its own greps
entities.summary: The repository does not follow the convention it states: every mark in it is an example or a definition, not a claim about a system.
entities.impact: Grepping this repository for ⚠️ or ❌ returns definitions and examples, not work to do, and the numbered documents carry no status line. The README's table of the four marks and the marks in templates/ are mentions; the templates' status lines are part of what an adopter copies.
